title: confed whoami result
description: The `result` of `confed whoami --json`: who the stored credentials authenticate as, and what this server can do.

server_version.description: Product version, e.g. "9.5.4". Data Center reports it; Cloud does not.

inline_comment_create.description: False on Data Center, which has no inline comment API. Attempting it exits 9.

adf.description: Whether the server speaks Atlassian Document Format.

move_between_spaces.description: Only with `--probe-move`, which sends a move request for one of this workspace's pages under a target that cannot exist: nothing moves, but it is a write request, so it is never sent unasked. `available`: the REST move endpoint answers. `web_action`: Data Center without it, whose web UI move action lets a script past its XSRF check; confed moves through it and reads each move back. `web_action_refused`: that check refuses scripts (403 "Session Expired"). `unavailable`: neither route exists. `unknown`: no pulled page to ask about, or an unclear answer. With any but the first two, `confed instance mv` exits 9.
